# Old vs New

`comparison/old-vs-new` &middot; section-level &middot; category: comparison

## Purpose

Two columns of points: the old way with dashes and the new way with check marks.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `old` | listItems |  |
| `new` | listItems |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | text |  |
| `oldTitle` | text | `"Before"` |
| `newTitle` | text | `"Now"` |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Old way on the left, new way on the right.
- **tinted**: On the page background color. Sets `background: @colors.background`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `paddingY` | length | `"@theme.section.paddingY"` |
| `paddingX` | length | `"@theme.section.paddingX"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Two columns as a table row, marks are text glyphs. | Stacking works. Non-Google Gmail accounts show the desktop layout on phones. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('comparison/old-vs-new', {
  "heading": "What is different in the new app",
  "oldTitle": "The old app",
  "newTitle": "The new app",
  "old": [
    "Sync every 15 minutes",
    "One project at a time",
    "Email-only notifications"
  ],
  "new": [
    "Instant sync across devices",
    "Switch projects in one tap",
    "Push, email and Slack notifications"
  ]
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "comparison/old-vs-new",
  "data": {
    "heading": "What is different in the new app",
    "oldTitle": "The old app",
    "newTitle": "The new app",
    "old": [
      "Sync every 15 minutes",
      "One project at a time",
      "Email-only notifications"
    ],
    "new": [
      "Instant sync across devices",
      "Switch projects in one tap",
      "Push, email and Slack notifications"
    ]
  }
}
```
